name: 投稿者の印を添えたコメント返信
prompt:
Create a clean, compact component image matching the Japanese native preview at exactly 390x134 proportions. Use the Japanese preview as the authority for localized copy, colors, and layout. Use the original Instagram crop for the comment/reply structure and the prior generated blue-link sample only as a cue for hyperlink color.

Exact visible Japanese text: ライトハウス, 投稿者, みなさん、ありがとうございます！, 返信する, 96, さらに18件の返信を見る. Preserve these strings exactly.

Show the author reply indented beneath the comment. Use a pale mint circular avatar with 光. Keep ライトハウス dark and bold. Keep 投稿者 green as an author badge, not a link. Use dark body text, a gray outline heart, and gray count 96. Use hyperlink blue #1976D2 for both clickable action labels 返信する and さらに18件の返信を見る. This follows the user’s explicit instruction that text presented as a hyperlink must be blue. Keep the small horizontal divider before the “more replies” action.

Match the preview’s compact spacing and alignment: avatar near x54/y10; text block near x98; heart and 96 at the right edge. White background, no extra card border, shadow, captions, or invented content. Preserve the blue verified badge as an icon in the original source context, but follow the Japanese preview’s mint initial avatar and author badge. Render every Japanese character accurately. No underlines are needed. Output only the component, with the same 390x134 aspect ratio.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
